description: This file provides utility functions for parsing and formatting Google OAuth API keys and usage tokens. It defines a type for the credential structure and includes functions for parsing API key strings into credential objects, formatting credential objects into JSON strings, and extracting tokens from API keys.

methods.name: export function parseGoogleOauthApiKey(apiKey: string): { parseGoogleOauthApiKey
methods.description: Parses a JSON string representing a Google OAuth API key into a credential object with optional token and projectId properties.

methods.name: export function formatGoogleOauthApiKey(cred: GoogleOauthApiKeyCredential): string { formatGoogleOauthApiKey
methods.description: Formats a credential object into a JSON string if it meets certain criteria (type 'oauth' and access is a non-empty string), otherwise returns an empty string.

methods.name: export function parseGoogleUsageToken(apiKey: string): string { parseGoogleUsageToken
methods.description: Attempts to extract a token from an API key string by parsing it as a credential. If parsing fails or token is absent, returns the original API key.

ctags.name: parsed
ctags.pattern: /^    const parsed = JSON.parse(apiKey) as { token?: unknown; projectId?: unknown };$/
